verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships AI features such as Semgrep Assistant and AI-Powered Detection, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The pack has no documented training-data policy or opt-out control. Local-only analysis ("code is never uploaded" by default) and the --dry-run no-upload flag are adjacent data-locality controls, not a guarantee or setting that prevents data from being used for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
